injection.header: workhorse.schedule_wait_v1(p_task_id uuid, p_worker_id text, p_fence_token bigint, p_wait_name text, p_duration_ms bigint, p_wake_at timestamptz) RETURNS TABLE (status text, wait_name text, mode text, duration_ms bigint, requested_wake_at timestamptz, wake_at timestamptz, attempt integer, fence_token bigint, worker_id text, created_at timestamptz)
injection.body: DECLARE v_polls integer := 0; BEGIN PERFORM nextval('workhorse.protocol_injected_wait_requested'); WHILE NOT (SELECT is_called FROM workhorse.protocol_injected_wait_released) LOOP IF v_polls >= 2000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'the runner never released the wait request' USING ERRCODE = '55000'; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.005); v_polls := v_polls + 1; END LOOP; RETURN QUERY SELECT 'scheduled'::text, w.wait_name, w.mode, w.duration_ms, w.requested_wake_at, w.wake_at, w.attempt, w.fence_token, w.worker_id, w.created_at FROM workhorse.task_wait w WHERE w.task_id = p_task_id AND w.wait_name = p_wait_name; END;
